audience._about: Yarin, 05 Nov 2026: double down on the buyers and the best selling books (shared/facts.json buyers and top_books, from his admin and Meta screenshots). Women 55 to 64 are the largest buying group and women 45+ made 58% of Meta attributed purchases by women, so grandmothers get their own series (8) next to mothers. Every reel names the store page its DM link opens ('page': books/<id> or gifts/<name>) and who it talks to ('audience').
audience.parents: mothers and both parents of children 1 to 8
audience.grandma: grandmothers buying for a grandchild; the site has a grandparent gift page (gifts/grandchild) that says the photo can be asked from the parents on WhatsApp and the preview is free before paying
audience.traditions: Yarin, 07 Nov 2026: test the religious and traditional audience (lumebook.com/IL/he/books/category/traditions, 33 books on 07 Nov). Series 9 talks to the same buyers (mothers, grandmothers) in traditional homes, with the traditional editions of the best sellers (הלב של אריאל = הלב של יובל, אח חדש and אחות חדשה) and the holiday and milestone books (החנוכה שלי, חלאקה). Never posted on Friday or Saturday. 07 Nov 2026 later (Yarin: 'half of the reels for the usual target audience and the other half for the religious/traditional audience'): from 15 Nov, the first day not filmed yet, 8 of the 16 reels are series 9 (all Sunday to Thursday) and 8 are the usual audience (every Friday and Saturday among them). Reels up to 14 Nov were filmed on 06 Nov and stay as they are.
